Initial release of AI Karaoke Video Maker Free — create lyric-synced karaoke videos easily.

- Upload audio or video files (MP3, MP4, WAV, MOV, up to 200MB) and generate synced karaoke videos with AI-powered lyric display.
- No manual editing required; describe your desired karaoke style (e.g., "bouncing karaoke text") for automatic rendering.
- Exports 1080p MP4 videos suitable for YouTube, TikTok, and karaoke apps.
- Built-in free token system with 100 credits and a 7-day expiry for new users; no registration needed.
- Multi-language support for user commands and backend responses, with smart error handling and workflow tips.
- Cloud-based rendering pipeline for fast, server-side processing—no install or design skills required.
